# ImovelWeb.com.br Scraper

<!-- This README is generated by .github/scripts/docs.py from the scraper code, its results/ folder and .github/scrapers.json: change those and run the script instead of editing it. -->

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/imovelweb-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/imovelweb-scraper.md)

Example scraper that collects property listing data from ImovelWeb.com.br, written in Python with the [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/) web scraping API. Part of [scrapfly-scrapers](../README.md).

- **Guide:** [How to Scrape Imovelweb Without Getting Blocked in 2026](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-imovelweb)
- **Code:** [`imovelweb.py`](imovelweb.py) · **Example run:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Tests:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Sample output:** [Property](results/property.json) · [Search](results/search.json)

## What it scrapes

- ImovelWeb property search results
- ImovelWeb individual property pages

## Functions

- `scrape_properties(urls)` → `List[Dict]`: Scrape detailed property data from imovelweb.com.br property pages.
- `scrape_search(location='sao-paulo-sp', property_type='imoveis', for_sale=False, max_pages=3)` → `Dict`: Scrape imovelweb.com.br search pages.

The functions are `async`: run them with `asyncio.run(...)` or `await` them.

### Example

The inputs are the examples of [`run.py`](run.py) (long lists cut short):

```python
import asyncio
import imovelweb


async def main():
    search = await imovelweb.scrape_search(
        location="sao-paulo-sp",
        property_type="apartamentos",
        for_sale=False,
        max_pages=3,
    )


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Output

The functions return plain dictionaries and lists. Fields of the sample output (top-level keys of the first item):

- [`results/property.json`](results/property.json): `url`, `currency`, `description`, `bedrooms`, `bathrooms`, `area_m2`, `phone`, `street`, `neighborhood`, `city`, `state`, `title`, `price_display`, `price`, `images`
- [`results/search.json`](results/search.json): `total_properties`, `total_pages`, `search_properties`

## Scrapfly settings

`BASE_CONFIG` in [`imovelweb.py`](imovelweb.py) holds the default settings of the requests, see the [Scrape API documentation](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `asp` = `True`: Anti Scraping Protection, the earlier name of the [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker)
- `proxy_pool` = `"public_residential_pool"`: proxy pool (datacenter or residential)
- `render_js` = `True`: render the page in a real browser
- `country` = `"BR"`: country of the proxy

## Quick start

Requires Python 3.10+ and [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/imovelweb-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # from https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # example scrape, saves its output in ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # the tests of this scraper
```

Tests: `test_search_scraping`, `test_property_scraping`; run one with `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` and the tests scrape the live website, so they use Scrapfly credits.
